DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway.description: Remove the spending limit for the account.
Remove the auto top-up configuration for the account. Dashboard sessions only: API token, OAuth, and service credentials are rejected with 403.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/bi.description: Retrieve the current credit balance, payment method info, and top-up configuration.

balance.description: Credit balance in US cents. Can be fractional, because usage is deducted in fractions of a cent, and is negative when usage overdraws it.

first_topup_success.description: Whether the account completed its first top-up. Auto top-up can be set up only after it.

has_default_payment_method.description: Whether AI Gateway billing has a default payment method for the account.

payment_method.description: The default payment method's card. Null when there is no default, it isn't a card, or it couldn't be read.

topup_config.description: Auto top-up configuration, as GET /topup/config returns it.

amount.description: Amount in cents that each auto top-up adds. 0 when auto top-up is off.

disabledReason.description: Why auto top-up was stopped. Present only once it stopped.

error.description: Message from the failure that stopped auto top-up. Present only once it stopped.

lastFailedAt.description: When auto top-up was stopped, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Present only once it stopped.

threshold.description: Balance threshold in cents that triggers an auto top-up. 0 when auto top-up is off.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/bi.description: Retrieve a list of past invoices with pagination, optionally filtered by type.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter invoice type: auto, manual, or all.

schema.description: Filter invoice type: auto, manual, or all.

amount_remaining.description: Amount still owed, in US cents.

auto_advance.description: Whether the invoice is finalized and collected without an explicit action. False for top-up invoices, which are charged when the top-up is made.

created.description: When the invoice was created, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

id.description: Invoice number, as printed on the invoice, rather than an identifier. Null until the invoice is finalized.

invoice_origin.description: How the top-up was made: `auto` or `manual`.

invoice_pdf.description: URL of the invoice PDF. Null until the invoice is finalized.

pagination.description: Pagination details. Results come in a single page.

has_more.description: Whether more invoices match than returned.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/bi.description: Retrieve a preview of the upcoming invoice including line items and tax.

amount_remaining.description: Amount still owed, in US cents.

id.description: Invoice number, as printed on the invoice, rather than an identifier. Empty until the invoice is finalized.

amount.description: Line item amount, in US cents.

end.description: End of the period, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

start.description: Start of the period, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

pretax_credit_amounts.description: Credits applied to the line item before tax.

credit_balance_transaction.description: Credit balance transaction identifier, when `type` is `credit_balance_transaction`.

unit_amount_decimal.description: Unit price in US cents, as a decimal string.

period_end.description: End of the billing period, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

period_start.description: Start of the billing period, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/bi.description: Retrieve the current spending limit configuration for the account.

duration.description: Window the limit applies to: `daily`, `weekly`, or `monthly`.

enabled.description: Whether a spending limit is enforced for the account.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/bi.description: Deprecated: use `auto_topup` from GET /topup/eligibility. Retrieve the current auto top-up threshold, amount, and any error state.

amount.description: Amount in cents that each auto top-up adds. 0 when auto top-up is off.

disabledReason.description: Why auto top-up was stopped. Present only once it stopped.

error.description: Message from the failure that stopped auto top-up. Present only once it stopped.

lastFailedAt.description: When auto top-up was stopped, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Present only once it stopped.

threshold.description: Balance threshold in cents that triggers an auto top-up. 0 when auto top-up is off.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/bi.description: Reports whether the account can top up: its payment methods and whether each can pay for a top-up, whether a manual top-up is available and its limits, and the auto top-up state. Advisory only: every top-up checks again. Answers 409 while this endpoint isn't available for the account yet.

can_configure.description: Whether auto top-up can be set up or changed now.

config.description: Configured threshold and amount. Null unless `state` is `active` or `needs_confirmation`.

amount_cents.description: Amount in cents that each auto top-up adds.

threshold_cents.description: Balance threshold in cents that triggers an auto top-up.

amount_max_cents.description: Maximum auto top-up amount in cents.

amount_min_cents.description: Minimum auto top-up amount in cents.

payment_method_id.description: Payment method auto top-up charges or, once stopped, the one it stopped on. Null when there is none to name.

state.description: `first_topup_required`: auto top-up can be set up after the first manual top-up. `not_configured`: auto top-up is off. `active`: auto top-up is on. `needs_confirmation`: auto top-up is on, but its card has to be confirmed or replaced. `stopped`: auto top-up was turned off; `stopped_reason` says why, when known.

stopped_reason.description: Why auto top-up stopped. Present only when `state` is `stopped` and the reason is known.

evaluated_at.description: When eligibility was evaluated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

available.description: Whether a manual top-up can be made now. True only when `status` is `ready`.

default_payment_method_id.description: Payment method to preselect: the default when it can pay, otherwise the first that can. Null when none can.

payment_methods.description: The account's payment methods, and whether each can pay for a top-up.

brand.description: Card brand. Present for cards, including cards saved in a wallet.

exp_month.description: Expiration month, 1 to 12. Present for cards, including cards saved in a wallet.

exp_year.description: Four-digit expiration year. Present for cards, including cards saved in a wallet.

is_default.description: Whether this is the account's default payment method.

last4.description: Last 4 digits. Present for cards, including cards saved in a wallet.

type.description: Payment method type. A card saved in a wallet has the wallet type and its card details. `link` is a card saved with Link, which has card details, or a Link payment that no card funds, which has none.

unusable_reason.description: Why this payment method can't pay for a top-up. Present only when `usable` is false.

usable.description: Whether this payment method can pay for a top-up.

reason.description: What prevents a manual top-up, or `NONE`. `CONTRACT_BILLING`: the account is billed by contract. `ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED`: the account is restricted. `ELIGIBILITY_UNAVAILABLE`: eligibility could not be determined. `NO_ELIGIBLE_PAYMENT_METHOD`: no payment method can pay for a top-up. `DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED`: the account reached its daily top-up limit.

status.description: `ready` when a manual top-up is available, `blocked` when `reason` prevents one, or `unavailable` when eligibility could not be determined and the request can be retried.

409.description: This endpoint isn't available for the account yet.

500.description: Eligibility couldn't be read, for example because the auto top-up configuration couldn't be read.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/bi.description: Deprecated: use `manual_topup.limits` from GET /topup/eligibility. Retrieve the minimum and maximum allowed top-up amounts (in cents) for this account.

max_cents.description: Maximum allowed top-up amount in cents.

min_cents.description: Minimum allowed top-up amount in cents.

GET /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/bi.description: Retrieve AI Gateway usage cost, in US dollars, aggregated by hour or day for the given time range.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start time as Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

schema.description: Start time as Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End time as Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

schema.description: End time as Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

aggregated_value.description: AI Gateway usage cost in the window, in US dollars.

end_time.description: End of the window (exclusive), as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

start_time.description: Start of the window, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/b.description: Deprecated: spending limits can no longer be created, enabled, or modified and this endpoint always responds 403. Use the new AI Gateway spend limits instead: https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/features/spend-limits/. Existing limits can be removed via DELETE /spending-limit.
Create a credit top-up for the given account, charged to the account's default payment method. Requires a dashboard session; API token, OAuth, and service credentials receive 403.

payment_method_id.description: Payment method to charge instead of the customer's default payment method.

client_secret.description: Client secret used to complete payment authentication.

onboarding.description: Whether the user was already onboarded.

402.description: Payment required — the payment method was declined, or it can't be used for top-ups and no payment was attempted. The error's `reason` and `action` tell the two apart.

503.description: Top-up is temporarily unavailable; no payment was initiated.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/b.x-forge-require-confirmation: This purchases AI Gateway credits and charges the amount to the account's default payment method.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/b.description: Configure auto top-up with a balance threshold and top-up amount. Requests that add a payment method first return authentication details. The configuration is saved only after the authenticated setup is submitted. Dashboard sessions only: API token, OAuth, and service credentials are rejected with 403.

threshold.description: Balance threshold in cents that triggers auto top-up (min 500).

consent_version.description: Version of the off-session auto-top-up consent accepted by the user.

contract_version.description: Set to 2 to pin auto top-up to this card instead of the default. Read when card setup starts; completion follows the setup.

payment_method_id.description: Card to authenticate for future automatic top-ups.

setup_idempotency_key.description: Client-generated UUID that makes payment-method setup safe to retry.

threshold.description: Balance threshold in cents that triggers auto top-up (min 500).

200.description: Auto top-up configuration saved, or card authentication required.

amount.description: Auto top-up amount in cents from the request.

threshold.description: Balance threshold in cents from the request.

amount.description: Auto top-up amount in cents from the request.

threshold.description: Balance threshold in cents from the request.

amount.description: Auto top-up amount in cents from the request.

client_secret.description: Client secret used to complete card authentication.

setup_intent_id.description: Card setup identifier to send back as `setup_intent_id` once authenticated.

status.description: The card must be authenticated with `client_secret` before auto top-up is saved. Then send the request again with `setup_intent_id`.

threshold.description: Balance threshold in cents from the request.

400.description: Bad request, or the payment method can't be used for auto top-up. A refused payment method carries the error's `reason` and `action`.

402.description: Payment required — the payment method was declined during activation.

409.description: Card setup is incomplete or already used, the default payment method changed, or synchronous activation disabled auto top-up.

503.description: Auto top-up setup is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/b.description: Deprecated: use GET /topup/eligibility, which reads the account's payment methods itself. This endpoint keeps working while that one answers 409 for the account. Reports whether the account can make a manual top-up, given the payment methods in the request body. Advisory only: every top-up checks again.

contract_version.description: Not accepted: any value answers 400. Read the current eligibility with GET /topup/eligibility.

payment_methods.description: The account's payment methods. Omit it, or send an empty list, when there are none.

default.description: Whether this is the account default payment method.

last_four.description: Last 4 digits, for display copy only.

type.description: Payment-method type. Absent or unrecognized is treated as non-card (does not error). Known values: PAYPAL, CREDIT_CARD, APPLE_PAY, GOOGLE_PAY, ACH_DIRECT_DEBIT, SEPA_DEBIT, CASHAPP, LINK, CRYPTO.

account_payment_method_state.description: Account-level payment-method state derived from the provided list.

aig_customer_state.description: AI Gateway billing profile resolution outcome.

aig_default_payment_method_state.description: Whether AI Gateway billing has a default payment method.

display_payment_method.description: Card to reference in the UI, e.g. "use card ending 1234".

reason.description: Canonical eligibility outcome for display and support triage.

recoverable.description: Whether the customer can resolve this themselves (vs contact support).

POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/b.description: Get the payment processing status of a top-up by its top-up identifier.

payment_intent_id.description: Top-up identifier to check status for.

status.description: `completed` once the top-up payment is processed and its credits are added to the balance, `pending` until then.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai/websearch.summary: Search the web through AI Gateway
POST /accounts/{account_id}/ai/websearch.description: Run a web search through a configured AI Gateway.
